title: Audio system: material×event bank, scale-aware acoustics, spatialized mix (AUTH #022)
summary: Build the v1 audio system per SPEC §3.6 and Movement Bible §9: a material × event sound bank covering every verb and tool, contact-frame-locked to the animation, layered + round-robin + impact-scaled; 3D spatialization with an ambience bed and category mix buses (movement/world/tools/UI/music) with sidechain ducking; scale-aware pitch/gain; scale-aware acoustic reverb computed from the reconstructed room (volume + material absorption); restrained adaptive music (ambient bed + sparse stings + the shrink-transition theme). CC0/royalty-free/self-recorded sourcing only.
deliverables: unity (audio engine, SurfaceMaterial event bank, reverb-from-scenegraph, mix buses)

acceptance_tests.test: The material × event bank covers all v1 verbs and tools (incl. grapple pin/twine, pole-vault, wall-run, dive-roll), fires on animation contact frames, and is round-robin + impact-scaled so a 2-minute run has no machine-gun repetition.
Scale-aware acoustic reverb is computed from the scene graph (room volume + material absorption) and audibly differs between a small dead room and a large live one.
acceptance_tests.evidence: A/B capture of two corpus rooms

acceptance_tests.test: Pitch, gain, and reverb size scale with the environment multiplier (Lego clicks tiny, floor booms big); category mix buses + ducking keep critical cues (summit/vista/flag) audible; audio is 3D-spatialized.
All audio is CC0/royalty-free/self-recorded with provenance recorded; the bank fits the mobile audio memory + polyphony budget.
It sounds real and alive on the Owner's iPhone.

history.event: created by the Coordinator as an AUTH #022 follow-up (audio system).
